content.rendered:
We are looking forward to seeing all of our returning families, and excited to meet our new Hawks View families! Our offices are now open, 7:30 to 3:30, if we can help you in any way.

Please find the supply list for 2023-24 HERE. If you need assistance with supplies, please contact our school counselor, Mrs. Allred, at sallred@sherwood.k12.or.us.

The SHARE Center also has clothing, shoes, backpacks, and school supplies for all ages and sizes. Appointments are required; to schedule your appointment, please contact Amy Gillett at agillett@sherwood.k12.or.us, or 503-825-5087.
